english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for making something or oneself ready in advance.
Use 準備 when dress means to prepare something for use or get it ready.
Use this when arranging means preparing something in advance, rather than making the overall arrangements.

examples.english: Remember to prepare the presentation for tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 記住準備聽日要用嘅簡報。
examples.jyutping: gei3 zyu6 zeon2 bei6 ting1 jat6 jiu3 jung6 ge3 gaan2 bou3

examples.english: I usually dress the salad just before we eat.
examples.traditional: 我通常食之前先準備個沙律。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 sik6 zi1 cin4 sin1 zeon2 bei6 go3 saa1 leot6

examples.english: Prepare the report so we can arrange the meeting.
examples.traditional: 你準備好份報告，我哋先可以安排開會。
examples.jyutping: nei5 zeon2 bei6 hou2 fan6 bou3 gou3 ngo5 dei6 sin1 ho2 ji5 on1 paai4 hoi1 wui2
